title: Remove the Last Defender
setup: The queen and bishop are both aimed at h7, and exactly one black piece is stopping them.
hint: Ask what would happen on h7 if a single black piece vanished, then work out what that piece is worth to Black.
explanation:
## The Idea

The queen on d3 and bishop on b1 aim at h7, and only the knight on f6 stops the queen landing there with mate.

{{Rxf6}} gives a rook for that knight. Take back with {{gxf6}} and {{Qxh7#}} follows: the bishop guards the queen, the queen covers g7 and h8, and f7 and f8 hold Black's own pawn and rook. Decline, and White is simply a knight up.

When one piece guards the mating square, weigh it against the mate.
